articles.title: Nigeria says two nationals killed in South Africa amid rise of anti-migrant attacks
articles.description: Nigeria's government said one of its nationals was reportedly killed by police officers "using gruesome interrogation techniques".

articles.title: Keiko Fujimori declared winner of Peru's presidential election weeks after vote
articles.description: The daughter of disgraced president Alberto Fujimori is declared winner of tight race nearly a month after voting took place.

articles.title: Ukrainian suspect hunted by police after Monaco bomb attack was 'disguised as a man'
articles.description: Officials believe the suspect may not have acted alone and spent days casing out the scene of the attack.

articles.title: Major Ukrainian drone attack on Russia strikes St Petersburg oil terminal
articles.description: Ukrainian drones have struck an oil terminal and port in St Petersburg and the surrounding region, Russian and Ukrainian officials say.
